mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_SEQ, M.EMAIL, M.NICKNAME, M.GENDER, M.MEMBER_STATUS AS status, M.CREATED_AT, B.MEMBER_BLACKLIST_SEQ, B.REASON AS blacklist_reason, B.ADMIN_MEMO, B.STATUS AS blacklist_status FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_BLACKLIST B ON M.MEMBER_SEQ = B.MEMBER_SEQ AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY M.MEMBER_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_BLACKLIST ( MEMBER_BLACKLIST_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, REASON, ADMIN_MEMO, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_BLACKLIST.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{blacklistReason}, #{adminMemo}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_BLACKLIST SET STATUS = 'RELEASED', RELEASED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT BANNED_WORD_SEQ, WORD, CATEGORY, REPLACEMENT, USE_YN, CREATED_AT FROM BANNED_WORD ORDER BY BANNED_WORD_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BANNED_WORD ( BANNED_WORD_SEQ, WORD, CATEGORY, REPLACEMENT, USE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_BANNED_WORD.NEXTVAL, #{word}, #{category}, NVL(#{replacement}, '***'), 'Y', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PHOTO_URL, AI_SCORE, IS_AI_SUSPECT, STATUS FROM PHOTO_REVIEW WHERE PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ = #{photoReviewSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE PHOTO_REVIEW SET STATUS = #{status}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, REVIEWED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ = #{photoReviewSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PHOTO_REVIEW ( PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PHOTO_URL, AI_SCORE, IS_AI_SUSPECT, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PHOTO_REVIEW.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{photoUrl}, NVL(#{aiScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{isAiSuspect, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'WAITING'), SYSDATE )
